description: This file defines the SlowConsumingPressureMonitor class, which implements ICachePressureMonitor to monitor cache pressure related to slow consumers in an Orleans streaming environment. It includes logic for tracking pressure contributions, determining pressure status, and logging pressure-related events.

classes.name: SlowConsumingPressureMonitor
classes.description: A pressure monitor that favors slow consumers in the cache, tracking cache pressure and logging status changes.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution, updating the maximum pressure in the current window.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Determines if the cache is under pressure based on the maximum pressure contribution and manages pressure state transitions.
